notes: Lag watch: 'monitor my PC while I game' logs CPU (and the busiest core), RAM, GPU load and temperature, disk, the busiest app, and router and internet ping every second. When the game closes (or 'stop monitoring') a panel lists each spike with what caused it, and Jarvis says the main cause: Wi-Fi, your internet or the game's servers, CPU, GPU, RAM or disk. No AI used.
